maddeler.e:
امتحنوا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَحَنُوا (imtaḥanū) /im.ta.ħa.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
# اُمْتُحِنُوا (umtuḥinū) /um.tu.ħi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
# اِمْتَحِنُوا (imtaḥinū) /im.ta.ħi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
